name: Soft Ground API Tester
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local desktop and self-hosted Docker API testing software; saved requests, history, variables, chained scenarios and CSV/JSON-driven test runs; no software seat or request quota advertised.
watch_out: Self-hosted deployment requires Docker and PostgreSQL; hosting, storage, target API usage and network costs are not included. Server executes requests and stores request/response history, so secure credentials and access before public exposure.
